column2: East desk supplied with visitor maps. Worn section of meadow path marked for reseeding.
Two chairs returned to the common room. One left by the piano for next Saturday.
Members signed out. Common-room piano closed.
Music in the west hall. The hall is empty.
Follow-up survey requested. The west hall is longer than it was on yesterday’s opening round.
Room 3 cleared. Mattress replaced. Room locked and key returned to the east desk.
Indentation found in the new Room 3 mattress on the wall side. Key envelope still sealed. See the residence record.
Laundry timer replaced. Collecting the old timer from the shelf continues to stop the new one.
One visitor returned a coat after finding a house key in the lining. She recognized the key. Her own was still on her ring.
Visitor knocked down at the library doors. Staff assisted her. She asked for the doors to be kept shut until her daughter had left.
Doors reopened at the chair’s request. Both latch plates now show wear. Last month’s photograph shows wear on one side.
Replaced the west-hall notice after the cleaning round. The old notice was still on the back of the new sheet.
Checked the library exit. The nearer door opens into the common room. This is the route currently shown on the east-desk map.
Hooks installed in Room 3. On the work order, the fellow’s request for a room without hooks appears in the box marked “Reason for installation.”
Former Room 3 resident called. The bedroom door at home opened onto the west hall. She asked that we leave the door alone. No change was visible from the Pavilion side.
East desk received the winter linen delivery. Two fitted sheets set aside for the next Room 3 allocation.
The west-hall door to Room 3 opened into a furnished bedroom. A child asked us to shut it. The door was closed. Chair requested that the 21:00 round remain on the schedule.
Room 3, second check. Door opened a few inches and caught on a chair. The child said, “I asked you to stop.” The previous observation has been entered as confirmed.
Room 3 still moved to the room file. Resident’s name removed from caption. The paper sleeve remains taped over the lens.
East desk filed a separate account for the visitor’s husband. A departure time had already been entered on his sheet. The arrival box was left blank.
Room 3 marked vacant after the closing check. The card had been turned to “occupied” when Operations returned to collect it. The key was still at the east desk.
One carbon sheet removed from the register at a visitor’s request. The next sheet carries the same departure time under a different name. Both were entered on the return.
Listening room reset for the next session. The singer’s copy was left in the archive per the chair’s instructions. Operations asked for a date to release it and were told to leave the box blank.
The second location was added to the night-round sheet under Room 3. The household’s number was removed. The line is still to be checked from the Pavilion side.
Second group confirmed the garden route. Added the gate to Saturday’s map. The owner’s request to keep it locked was filed with the old map.
Checked the garden route. The green wayfinding stake was on the inside of the gate. The gate was locked from the street and the key was still with the owner.
Updated the common-room photograph in the leadership archive. The new caption lists five people.
Hung the replacement leadership photograph in the common room.
